draft: The Secretary-General should report annually to the Security Council on how climate change affects international peace and security in situations on the Council’s agenda, with assessments tailored to each region and issue and informed by existing reporting under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Paris Agreement.

history.text: We accept the annual UN report as a first step toward comprehensive reporting on the links between climate and security.

The United Nations should address climate impacts through existing reporting under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Paris Agreement, with the participation of all developing countries and attention to implementation of the Glasgow Climate Pact, including commitments on climate finance and technology transfer.

IND.reason: Annual Security Council reporting would establish a separate climate–security link. India supports addressing climate impacts through the existing inclusive UN climate process.

FRA.reason: Annual reporting tailored to each region and issue would help the Security Council assess climate-related security risks in situations on its agenda.
